start.text: Report sent. Anna's password is reset and the unknown computer is blocked. But I doubt that's the end of it.
start.name: Joshua

C.text: Joshua, it's Carla. I'm on call tonight. I read your report. Nice work.
C.name: Carla

D.text: But whoever did this still knows how we sign in. They may try another account tonight.
D.name: Carla

E1.text: Sign-ins at strange hours, from computers we don't know, or from outside the office.
E1.name: Carla

E2.text: Not yet. We don't know which account they will use, so we watch every sign-in.
E2.name: Carla

F.text: The rules are in the [b][color=green]rulebook[/color][/b]. [b][color=red]Report[/color][/b] what breaks them, and let the rest pass.
F.name: Carla

G.text: Got it. One sign-in at a time.
G.name: Joshua

H.text: A false alarm wastes our time, and a missed one lets them in. I have to be careful with both.
H.name: Joshua
